user.title: Sign in to HappyParking
user.description:
### [→ Open the HappyParking login page]({login_url})

Sign in there exactly as you always do — **Kakao** or your **HappyParking id**.

Once you are signed in, copy your login token out of that page and paste it below:

1. Press **F12** to open the browser's developer tools.
2. Go to **Application** → **Local Storage** → `https://app.hparking.co.kr`.
3. Copy the value of **`token`** (a long string of letters and numbers).

Your building's parking server, your app user id and your site code are all read out of that token, so there is nothing else to fill in. The token is used once, here, and is not sent anywhere but your own parking server.

*If your login sent you back to an address containing the token, you can paste that whole address instead.*

*No browser to hand?* Leave the box empty and submit to sign in another way.
